concurrency.adminOnly: Concurrency settings are managed by the Admin. You don't have access to this page.
concurrency.about.label: About concurrency
concurrency.about.content: How many project containers may run at once, and how much memory each may use.
concurrency.intro: Containers start on demand when an agent run or the assistant needs one, and stop after sitting idle. These limits bound what a burst of agent activity can take on this machine.
concurrency.memoryBudget.label: Total container memory
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.scope: Total memory all project containers may use at once. The assistant's container runs on top of it.
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.queue: A run whose container will not fit waits in the queue until memory frees up. The assistant always starts.
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.automatic: On automatic, Hezo sizes this from host memory, keeping {reserved} GB free for the system and one container's worth for the assistant.
concurrency.memoryBudget.point.range: Whole number of GB from {min} to {max}.
concurrency.memoryBudget.formulaAuto: Automatic: {ram} GB RAM + {swap} GB swap = {total} GB, less {reserved} GB for the system and {chat} GB for the assistant = {usable} GB.
concurrency.memoryBudget.formulaSet: Set explicitly. The automatic value for this host would be {value} GB.
concurrency.ramCap.label: RAM cap per container (GB)
concurrency.ramCap.point.limit: The memory limit applied to every project container.
concurrency.ramCap.point.overCap: A container that grows past the cap is stopped instead of taking down the server.
concurrency.ramCap.point.divisor: It also divides host memory into the automatic limit above, so a higher cap means fewer containers.
concurrency.ramCap.point.override: Projects that need more can override it in their own settings.
concurrency.ramCap.point.range: Whole number from {min} to {max}. Defaults to {default}.
concurrency.rangeError: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.

container.strandedCommits.title: Committed work has not reached a remote
container.strandedCommits.body: A push to this project's git remote was refused, so those commits exist only inside one container. Hezo keeps that container alive until a later run pushes them. Check the repository's push access.
